source_revision.gazetteer_feature_type: named populated place, not place of worship

policy: Only unique named locality in same country; for US require full-state match from original state abbreviation
Same-name places >5km apart are ambiguous even if in same administrative region
Country-only and regional defaults cannot create a pin
Known aliases, closed sites and identity holds cannot auto-publish
Keep original CL2 source IDs, original address, labels and ecclesiastical UNKNOWN
Locality coordinates are illustrative: no entrance accuracy, active Mass, route/drive distance or liturgical-book claims
Google Maps search destination must be built from sourced name/address, never GeoNames centroid
Do not copy provisional locality geometry into exact-site photo-location audit
Any diocesan source-city conflict or locally disputed host must remain unpinned even if city can be geocoded
Excel All Venues approved site-precision proposals supersede locality centroids; Excel Needs more evidence identity holds remain unpinned
Existing CL2 batch08–17 identity/naming holds override generic locality acceptance even when gazetteer joins match towns: Kłodzko RG-B66-ACD5E3A16E10, San Jose RG-18E53EDD9E9C
